Apple invests $30 billion in Broadcom for US chip production

Apple has announced a significant expansion of its partnership with Broadcom, committing over $30 billion to the deal. This investment aims to facilitate the production of billions of US-made chips and will lead to the expansion of a Broadcom factory in Colorado. The agreement underscores Apple's ongoing strategy to diversify its chip manufacturing base.
